translations.web: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
translations.bsb: He asked them, “What are you discussing so intently as you walk along?” They stood still, with sadness on their faces.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
translations.asv: And he said unto them, What communications are these that ye have one with another, as ye walk? And they stood still, looking sad.
